Hi!

Is there any other CL client which have flag similar to Lighthouse --always-prepare-payload which always sends FCU with PayloadAttributes?

Having a tool for a proper block production and validation flow, it works but once in a time some blocks are rejected due to invalid blockhash and wat to ensure it is not a issue with a paylaod attributes.
